value: Two-step verification is a requirement for all Shine Online Banking accounts; Dupaco cannot remove this security feature or the alerts that follow
quote: Two-step verification is a requirement for all Shine Online Banking accounts. We're unable to remove this security feature from your account as well as the alerts that follow.

value: Add a mobile number to receive two-step codes via text instead of email, in Shine Mobile or Shine Online
quote: If you don't want to receive your two-step codes via email, add your mobile number to receive codes via text instead.
qualifiers: Members who don't want email two-step codes

value: Profile > 'Two Step Notification' > 'Add contact', enter number and follow prompts
quote: Once you're logged in, you can add your number via the "Two Step Notification" option of your Profile. Select "Add contact", enter your number, and follow the prompts.

value: Mouse over 'Profile', select 'Edit Profile', then under 'Actions' select 'edit two-step' and follow prompts
quote: mouse over "Profile", select on "Edit Profile". Under the "Actions" menu on the right hand side, select "edit two-step"

value: Enable face or fingerprint recognition or set up PIN Login via Device Security section of Profile
quote: Enable face or fingerprint recognition or setup PIN Login. Once you're logged in, you can configure either option from the Device Security section of your Profile.

value: Choose 'Trust this device' on login screen
quote: Choose "Trust" this device" (on your login screen). Doing so secures your account with the most recent login code entered.
qualifiers: Not recommended for computers or devices you don't own

attribute: transaction, balance or statement alert management
value: Log in to Shine Online Banking and go to the eNotifiers section to configure transaction, balance or statement alerts
quote: To manage these alerts please login to Shine Online Banking and navigate to the eNotifiers section
please give us a call at 800-373-7600, ext. 0 or contact us at service@dupaco.com.
qualifiers: Received verification code or transaction alert not belonging to member
Received verification code or transaction alert not belonging to member

value: Dupaco will remove the member's number or email from the associated account upon call or email
quote: we will remove your number or email from the associated account.
qualifiers: Transaction or account alert that isn't yours

value: Dupaco will never ask for personal or account information in an email
quote: we'll never ask you to provide personal or account information in an email.
